title: Dental crown
what: A crown is an artificial cap placed over a damaged tooth. It protects the tooth and brings back its shape.
why: When a tooth is badly damaged, after root canal treatment, with a very large filling, or on an implant.
duration: usually 2 visits of 1 to 2 hours, 1 to 2 weeks apart
tell_doctor: Allergies to numbing medicines or metals
If you grind your teeth in your sleep

prepare.title: Treatment
prepare.text: Before a crown, the tooth often needs treatment: root canals are filled and a base is built. Your dentist will tell you the plan.

prepare.title: X-ray
prepare.text: A tooth X-ray is usually taken to check the roots.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat before your visit. After the numbing shot, eating is hard for a couple of hours.

bring: Dental X-rays, if you had any
steps: First visit: you get a numbing shot
The tooth is carefully shaped so the crown can fit on it
An impression is taken, or the tooth is scanned with a camera
The crown color is matched to your teeth
A temporary crown is put on while the real one is made
Second visit: the crown is tried on and your bite is checked
The crown is fixed in place with special cement
feel: After the numbing shot: only pressure and vibration
If it hurts, tell the dentist. You will get more numbing medicine
The impression material may taste unpleasant. It does not last long
after: Numbness wears off in 2 to 3 hours. It is better not to eat until then
With a temporary crown, do not chew sticky or hard food on that side
For a few days the tooth may react to cold and hot
If the crown gets in the way when you bite, come back for an adjustment
red_flags: Strong swelling of the cheek or face, or a fever
Strong pain that gets worse and does not ease with pain medicine

faq.a: Metal-ceramic crowns are strong and cost less. Ceramic and zirconia crowns look more natural. Your dentist will advise what is best for your tooth.

faq.q: What if my temporary crown falls out?
faq.a: Keep it and call your dentist. It will be put back. Without it, the tooth may shift or hurt.
